definitions.text: Soul DNA is the compressed transcript of eight months of operator interaction with AI systems. It is not a philosophy but a behavioral lawbook derived from repeated corrections.
Soul DNA = intent layer derived from prompts. Code artifacts are downstream from Soul DNA.
L3_SOUL_DNA (Intent): what Michael actually wanted, the distilled intent, the law behind the request... ZERO_SUMMARIZATION rule applies: L3 must carry verbatim raw voice, not paraphrase.
Soul DNA is the full chain: Intention / Raw language / Friction / pushback / Corrections / Decisions / Execution / Failure / Recovery / Victory / Next intent
Soul DNA is the user prompts. Period. Not the code. Not the infrastructure. Not the model. Not the architecture diagram. The user prompts.
